name: keepgoing
description: A Stop hook for Claude Code and Codex that requests one final completion pass, with an opt-in infinite mode.

interface.shortDescription: Request one final completion pass before stopping.
interface.longDescription: Ask Claude Code or Codex to check for unfinished work once before stopping, with an explicitly enabled infinite mode for experiments.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain how the keepgoing completion hook works and how to configure it.
